subject.title: fix(ai): honor Responses reasoning effort maps

question: Should encrypted reasoning replay remain enabled only for `provider: openai` and the Azure Responses API route, while all other Responses-compatible providers receive only provider-native reasoning effort?
rationale: This is a shared provider-compatibility contract: tests cover OpenAI, Azure, and a Groq-shaped compatible model, but the permanent classification boundary determines whether future compatible routes preserve or omit continuation state.

options.title: Confirm the current capability boundary
options.body: Accept native OpenAI plus Azure Responses as the replay-capable routes and merge the focused canonical-map fix.

options.title: Define a model capability instead
options.body: Replace provider/API identity inference with explicit replay support metadata if additional Responses-compatible routes need different continuation behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm the current capability boundary
recommendation.body: Accept native OpenAI plus Azure Responses as the replay-capable routes and merge the focused canonical-map fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and the compatibility-sensitive scope make the current reviewer the best available decision owner.
